evals.prompt: Run a localization audit of the iOS app in ~/Documents/git/knmi-app-ios (current checkout).
evals.expected_output: Dutch and English app with one String Catalog per Swift package: checks every catalog and that each package passes its own bundle. Determines the supported languages from the project (knownRegions, String Catalog source and target languages, Info.plist) and reports disagreements. Reports completeness per supported language with counts per String Catalog state, user-facing text that bypasses localization (separating it from logs, identifiers, debug, previews, and tests), strings in packages looked up in the wrong bundle, placeholder and plural mismatches, concatenated sentences, fixed date and number formats, and untranslated permission texts. Lists every area as findings, checked without findings, or not applicable, uses the company severity labels and the review-ios output shape, and edits or builds nothing.
